adverse_drug_reactions.1% to 10%: Central nervous system: Local discomfort (scalp), localized burning, localized numbness, tingling of skin; Dermatologic: Pruritus, erythema, skin rash (scalp), stinging of the skin; Local: Localized edema

monitoring_parameters: Assess head, hair, and skin surfaces for presence of lice and nits. Teach patient appropriate application
